ns2:course.label: Contaminant Fate and Transport
ns2:course.description: Quantitative study of the chemical, physical, and microbiological processes controlling the mobility, reaction, and transformation of pollutants in flowing groundwater. Prerequisite: GEOL 460 or GEOL 560 or CEE 443 or CEE 534; and GEOL 470 or GEOL 570 or CEE 457 or CEE 557; or consent of instructor.
